summary_en: 550,000 shares (5.17% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-10 at ¥1,290/share; total yen value up to ¥709.5M. Execution window single trading session; settlement after market close.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Treasury Share Purchase via ToSTNeT-3 Off-Exchange Trading
translation_en_brief: Mino Ceramic Co., Ltd. announced on 2026-08-07 that its board of directors approved the acquisition of up to 550,000 treasury shares via off-exchange ToSTNeT-3 trading. The acquisition is planned for 2026-08-10 at ¥1,290 per share (the prior day's closing price including final special quotation), with a total outlay of up to ¥709.5M. The purchase order is valid only during the designated trading session (08:45 JST), and results will be disclosed immediately after market close. The stated purposes are to cover shares granted under restricted stock award arrangements and to enable flexible capital policy execution and improved capital efficiency. As of 2026-06-30, the company held 2,273,704 treasury shares and had 10,636,124 shares outstanding (excluding treasury). The 550,000-share limit represents 5.17% of shares outstanding ex-treasury.
